Thank you for sending that, it actually answers the question. The parcel was never released for you to collect, it sat in the locker, and on 29 October DHL sent it back to the sender. So there is nothing left to chase and no pickup code coming. At least we now know, instead of you waiting on a trace.

That means a new power supply has to be bought and sent to you, and I have put exactly that in front of the team this morning with your tracking history and your address attached. They start at 10am Eastern today. The returned parcel is our problem to settle with Amazon, not yours.

One thing that will help: when the new one goes out, we will send it so it needs a signature or goes to a pickup point you choose, rather than a locker you get no code for. If there is a better address for you during the day, a work address or a neighbour, tell me and I will have it sent there instead.

You will hear the tracking here in this thread.

Best regards,
Sarah
